events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese's Wit
angles.copy: From Python to hotelier, we're celebrating the legendary wit of John Cleese today as he turns 87. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped the 'White Album'. Which track from that legendary double LP still gets you every time?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain legendary. What's your ultimate Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul,' was released in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Milestone
angles.copy: It's 61 years since The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that saw them evolve their sound. Which track defines it for you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: We remember John Lennon, who passed away 46 years ago today and would have been 86.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Message
angles.copy: 46 years since the world lost John Lennon. His music and message continue to resonate. What's the Lennon track that means the most to you?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The legendary musician and cultural icon David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's Influence
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman, David Bowie, who would have been 80 today. His influence on music and style is simply immeasurable. Which Bowie era is your favourite?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have turned 92 today.

angles.name: King of Rock and Roll
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the King, Elvis Presley, who would have been 92 today. His legacy continues to shake, rattle, and roll. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's sound. What's the ultimate Zeppelin riff for you?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Rock and pop icon Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rod the Mod
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! From Faces to solo superstardom, his voice is unmistakable. What's your favourite Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Mark 'Suggs' McPherson, the iconic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Madness Frontman
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the inimitable voice of Madness! Which track always gets you skanking?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home),' celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: The Voice of Paul Young
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! That voice defined a generation. What's your favourite from his incredible catalogue?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary country music icon and philanthropist Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true legend of music, business, and pure joy. What's your go-to Dolly track?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman, singer-songwriter, and TV personality Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Take That's Leader
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That to solo success, he's given us countless hits. Which one is your favourite?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: The Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Smooth Operator
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the smooth voice of Billy Ocean! Get out your 'Red Light Spells Danger' and celebrate with us. What's your favourite Billy track?

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's first induction
events.blurb: The inaugural Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place in 1989, honouring pioneers like Chuck Berry, James Brown, and Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: 38 years since the first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction. Who was your must-have artist for that first class, and who do you still think deserves a spot?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Take That's Mark
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! From boyband heartthrob to solo artist, he's still going strong. What's your favourite Mark moment?

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London on January 30, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Rooftop Gig
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles took to the rooftop for their legendary final live performance. An iconic moment in music history. What's your favourite track from that set?

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter and Genesis drummer Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Musical Powerhouse
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the one and only Phil Collins! A true musical powerhouse, from Genesis to solo superstardom. What's your ultimate Phil track?

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: The beloved British actor Hugh Grant, known for his roles in romantic comedies, celebrates his 67th birthday.

angles.name: British Charm
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the charming Hugh Grant! From 'Four Weddings' to 'Notting Hill', his films are quintessential British viewing. What's your favourite Grant role?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar, singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: Prince of Pop
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From boyband beginnings to solo sensation, he's done it all. What's your favourite JT hit?

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British actor Sir David Jason, famous for roles as Del Boy and Detective Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: National Treasure
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! From Peckham to Poplar, his characters are etched into British TV history. What's your favourite Del Boy quote?

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since the tragic plane crash that killed music legends Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and 'The Big Bopper' J.P. Richardson in 1959.

angles.name: Remembering the Legends
angles.copy: Remembering 'The Day The Music Died', 68 years on. A tragic loss of Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper. Their music lives on.
